title: Env-proxy WORK_STORE_TOKEN overwrites Authorization on every ict-bot.duckdns.org request from the ICT env -> diag Transport A (diag_fetch.sh) 401s
note: Found 2026-11-05T06:43Z by lane WSD-S1-STORE-API (session_01AFoLuJFu3NEJt21ZKxx7N1), caused by its own D3 step: request_credential saved a Bearer network secret for ict-bot.duckdns.org on env ICT; the proxy now REPLACES Authorization on every request to that host, so scripts/ops/diag_fetch.sh 'version' returns answered_401 (MEASURED 06:43Z). Unaffected: the issue relay (Transport B), runner-side callers, browser SPA. Same collision for any other bearer a session sends to this host (DASHBOARD_API_TOKEN routes). Options sent to the manager: (A, recommended) work_items accepts X-Work-Store-Token (Bearer kept as fallback) + operator re-saves the network secret with header_name X-Work-Store-Token, no prefix (one form; same value, or rotate); (B) diag router accepts DIAG_READ_TOKEN in X-Diag-Token and diag_fetch.sh sends it (no operator act, widens diag gate, trap stays); (C) interim: operator deletes the network secret (Transport A back, session writes 401 until A). CLOSES WHEN: diag_fetch.sh 'version' exits 0 from an ICT-env session AND a session write to /api/bot/work/items still returns 201.
